settings.title: Who is this for?
settings.content:
• ReStore: Designed for mature, aging, or dry skin
  • ReNu: Ideal for sensitive, stressed, or acne-prone skin
  • Replenish Spritzer: Perfect for all skin types needing lightweight, hydrating support

Best For:
Skincare professionals, microcurrent users, or anyone wanting flexible, skin-specific care during treatments.

settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
1. Cleanse your skin thoroughly using the Mangosteen cleanser before treatment.
  2. Select the appropriate gel or spritzer based on the skin's needs:
  • Use ReStore to lift and support aging skin.
  • Use ReNu to soothe and calm stressed skin.
  • Use Replenish Spritzer to hydrate and refresh dry or dehydrated skin.

3. Apply a generous amount (or spritz evenly) onto the treatment area.

4. Perform your microcurrent session using a MyoLift device.

5. After treatment, massage in or rinse off any remaining product.

6. Follow with the Anti Aging Peptide Serum or Revital C.

settings.title: Product Features
settings.content:
• Hands-Free Design: Allows for multitasking during treatment sessions.
  • Reusable: Each mask can be used for 10–12 treatments or until the conductivity bar no longer stays solid.
  • No Conductive Gel Required: Simplifies the treatment process.
  • Compatible with MyoLift™ Devices: Designed to work seamlessly with MyoLift™ QT Plus and MyoLift™ Mini.
  • FDA Approved: Ensures safety and efficacy.

settings.heading: How this bundle works
settings.section_content: This 3-in-1 gel bundle lets you personalize every microcurrent session. Use ReStore to lift and firm aging skin, ReNu to calm and rebalance stressed or breakout-prone skin, and Replenish Spritzer to hydrate before or during treatment. Each product enhances conductivity while delivering targeted skin benefits.

settings.heading: Better Together
settings.image_content: When used together, these formulas support every step of your treatment—hydrating, calming, and tightening as needed. Whether you're a pro or treating yourself at home, this bundle gives you flexible, pro-grade results without the guesswork.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: Is this safe for sensitive skin?
settings.text1: Yes, ReNu and Replenish are especially gentle and calming.
settings.title2: Can I use these every day?
settings.text2: Yes! They’re made for regular microcurrent use.
settings.title3: Do they work with any device?
settings.text3: Yes, they’re compatible with all microcurrent tools.
settings.title4: Do I have to rinse them off?
settings.text4: No—just massage the leftover gel in, or rinse if you prefer.
settings.title5: Can I mix and match the products?
settings.text5: Absolutely! Use each one based on your skin’s current needs.
settings.title6: Is this bundle okay for oily or acne-prone skin?
settings.text6: Yes, especially ReNu and Replenish—they help calm and balance oily skin.
